name: agentic-browser
description: A desktop browser that people and AI agents share. See docs/SPEC.md.

scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run build:browser && npm run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/browser && tsc -p evals/agent/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test "packages/protocol/test/*.test.mjs" && npm run test --workspace apps/browser && node scripts/test-cli.mjs
